nativeFinalBuildCheck.note: The six-slot fresh-mobile check above was measured before Native restoration; final Native placement was additionally checked in the four-slot desktop document and after resizing. Positions are not recreated on resize.

fixes: Each slot caches one iframe per size and switches formats on breakpoint changes without repeated automatic refreshes.
An oversized banner is not loaded into a narrow content column.
Same-origin messages from the corresponding iframe report script-loaded or script-error, not filled or impression.
Timeouts and cleanup remove timers, media and resize listeners, observers and iframe nodes.
Popunder uses the Next.js Script lifecycle with load and error status handlers.
Native is restored as the first middle placement when a middle position exists; its fixed container occurs once per document and is not stacked with a banner.
unresolved: The supplied third-party scripts return 403 in this test environment; the reason is not established and production-domain behavior cannot be inferred.
Multiple banner placements still share the same supplied key per format. The provider advises distinct codes for same-size banners on one page.
Pages with less than 640px of body content cannot satisfy both two fixed endpoint slots and a 640px body-content gap without adding artificial space.
